existing_terminology:
No disorder category, service or school-language provision is named anywhere in it
Sourced absence, not an inference: 'speech' 0 in 147,617 chars of the cited report
Sanity check on the same text: 'Holy See' 136, 'Vatican' 15, 'school' 16
The report answers concluding observations on education, girls, health and the CRC
existing_identificationCriteria: Not established from the sources consulted. The Holy See's second periodic report to the Committee on the Rights of the Child records that children of Vatican City State attend legally recognised schools under various State legislation, and describes no school system inside the territory, so no body there identifies a language disorder.
existing_referralPathway:
Prescription from a doctor outside the fund needs approval by a DSI polyclinic doctor
Gynaecology, paediatric, eye, dental and dermatology visits need no prior authorisation
The prescribing doctor sets the priority band that governs access
If a deferrable service cannot be booked in 30 days an outside centre may be used
existing_serviceModel:
The DSI polyclinic's own service list has paediatrics and ENT but no logopedia
Therapy is bought in: FAS contracts named logopedia providers, all at Rome addresses
Each episode needs prior authorisation from a DSI or FAS-contracted doctor
Covers clergy, Vatican citizens and residents, and Holy See staff insured by the FAS fund
existing_legalEntitlement:
There is no national school system, so no support framework exists to record
The Holy See's own report to the UN says children attend schools elsewhere
The report names no health or education service inside the territory
Any entitlement therefore arises under the law of the State running the school
existing_funding:
The FAS health fund pays, via the DSI polyclinic or providers contracted to the fund
Indirect route: the family pays first and claims a pre-authorised reimbursement
Reimbursement uses the DSI tariff for anything its own polyclinic could have provided
The patient's share of the cost is paid at the counter before the service is given
Choosing an outside contracted provider over a DSI clinic leaves the tariff difference to pay
existing_workforce: Not established from the sources consulted. Neither the Direzione di Sanita e Igiene nor the Fondo Assistenza Sanitaria publishes any count of speech and language therapists. The FAS names six contracted logopedia providers by name, street address and telephone number, and the DSI's own list of services provided at its polyclinic runs from angiologia to medicina dei viaggi without naming logopedia.

docLinks.label: Vice-rectorat des îles Wallis et Futuna — Scolarisation des élèves en situation de handicap (web.archive.org mirror; ac-wf.wf will not accept connections from this pipeline)

existing_identificationCriteria:
Needs are assessed with the national GEVASCO grids and the standard PPS form
The Equipes de Suivi de Scolarite work at the pupil's own place of schooling
existing_referralPathway:
Human support follows a family request and a notification by the CTHD
The CSPE draws up the PPS, standing in for the MDPH evaluation team
The CTHD then validates the PPS, in place of the CDAPH
existing_serviceModel:
ULIS units run in three schools and two colleges across Wallis and Futuna
No medico-social or health establishment on the islands can take a disabled child
Inclusion is therefore the core of the scheme, full time or part time in school
existing_legalEntitlement: The 2005 French disability rights law is not applied, given the territory's status
existing_funding:
Health spending on the territory is borne by the State
The State bears health cover under article 68 of the 1972 finance law
The Agence de santé is funded by the Ministry of Overseas France as financeur
There is no social security body and no sickness insurance fund in Wallis and Futuna
existing_workforce:
The Agence de santé employs 200 people, including eight general practitioners
There is no private medical practice on the islands, so care runs through the agency
The agency provides outpatient care in dentistry and functional rehabilitation
No orthophoniste is named among the staff the agency lists
